'''Remedan''', known as '''Remedan the Goldentongued''', was a King of [[Aelgar]].

== History ==
In {{ab|209}}, King Remedan signed the [[Compact of the Ten Nations]] on behalf of Aelgar.{{ref/book|bwb}}
